what_to_detect: An entity on the board whose snapshot colours equal the colours of the mana symbols in its mana cost (hybrid and Phyrexian symbols included), with no static contributing a colour.
near_miss: An entity whose mana cost has no coloured symbol and whose snapshot colours are empty.

what_to_detect: An entity with no mana cost whose snapshot colours equal its colour indicator's colours.
near_miss: An entity with no mana cost and no colour indicator whose snapshot colours are empty.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect is conditioned on comparing an object's mana value (a Condition*$ on cmc in the acting line's script), the condition met so the conditioned effect happens, e.g. a spell is countered, the compared mana value counting every mana symbol, a Phyrexian symbol as 1.
near_miss: A resolution of the same mana-value-conditioned effect whose condition is unmet, so the conditioned effect does not happen.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect is conditioned on comparing an object's mana value (a Condition*$ on cmc in the acting line's script), the condition met so the conditioned effect happens, e.g. a spell is countered, an object with no mana cost compared at mana value 0.
near_miss: A resolution of the same mana-value-conditioned effect whose condition is unmet, so the conditioned effect does not happen.

what_to_detect: An entity showing the back face of a nonmodal double-faced card whose snapshot mana value is its front face's mana value.
near_miss: An entity that is a copy of such a back face, with snapshot mana value 0.

what_to_detect: A melded permanent whose snapshot mana value is the sum of its component front faces' mana values.
near_miss: A copy of a melded permanent, with snapshot mana value 0.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect is conditioned on comparing an object's mana value (a Condition*$ on cmc in the acting line's script), the condition met so the conditioned effect happens, e.g. a spell is countered, a split card's mana value being its halves' combined off the stack or fused, and the cast half's alone otherwise.
near_miss: A resolution of the same mana-value-conditioned effect whose condition is unmet, so the conditioned effect does not happen.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect is conditioned on comparing an object's mana value (a Condition*$ on cmc in the acting line's script), the condition met so the conditioned effect happens, e.g. a spell is countered, an {X} counting 0 off the stack and the chosen X on it.
near_miss: A resolution of the same mana-value-conditioned effect whose condition is unmet, so the conditioned effect does not happen.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect is conditioned on comparing an object's mana value (a Condition*$ on cmc in the acting line's script), the condition met so the conditioned effect happens, e.g. a spell is countered, a hybrid symbol counting its largest component.
near_miss: A resolution of the same mana-value-conditioned effect whose condition is unmet, so the conditioned effect does not happen.
